why_en: No bank or real company will ever ask for your OTP or code
why_pcm: No bank go ever ask you for OTP or code
examples: Send the OTP we sent to you to reactivate
Kindly share the code sent to your phone
Abeg forward the verification code wey enter your phone

why_en: Asks for your PIN, password or card details
why_pcm: Dem dey ask for your PIN, password or card details
examples: Kindly send your BVN and PIN to confirm
Confirm your ATM card details to avoid suspension

why_en: Asks you to send or 'update' your BVN or NIN
why_pcm: Dem wan make you send or 'update' your BVN or NIN
examples: Update your BVN now to avoid restriction
Kindly send your BVN and PIN

why_en: Threatens to block your account to rush you
why_pcm: Dem dey threaten say dem go block your account make you rush
examples: Your GTB account will be blocked today
Your SIM will be barred in 24 hours

pattern: \b(?:urgent(?:ly)?|immediately|within (?:1|2|12|24|48) ?(?:hours?|hrs?|mins?|minutes)|right now|act now|last warning|final notice|before (?:midnight|today ends)|sharp sharp|quick quick|now now)\b
why_en: Pushes you to act fast so you don't think
why_pcm: Dem dey rush you make you no get time think

why_en: Classic fake-alert trick: 'I sent too much, refund me'
why_pcm: Na old fake alert trick: 'I send pass, refund me'
examples: I mistakenly sent 50k to your account, please refund
I transferred excess, kindly refund the balance

why_en: Looks like a credit alert: confirm in your bank app, not the SMS
why_pcm: E resemble credit alert: check your bank app, no trust SMS
examples: Credit Alert: N50,000 has been credited

why_en: Promises guaranteed or multiplied returns: that is how Ponzi schemes talk
why_pcm: Dem dey promise sure profit or double money: na Ponzi talk be dat
examples: We double your USDT in 24 hours

why_en: Unrealistic percentage return in a short time
why_pcm: The percentage wey dem promise too much for short time

why_en: Asks you to pay a fee before you get the job, loan or prize
why_pcm: Dem wan make you pay fee before you collect job, loan or prize

pattern: \b(?:work from home|earn (?:up to )?(?:₦|ngn|n|\$)?\s?[\d,]+k?\s*(?:daily|weekly|per day|a day|per week)|no experience (?:needed|required)|data entry job|online job)\b
why_en: Easy money job offer, common bait for fee scams
why_pcm: Easy money job, na bait for fee scam

why_en: Says you won something you never entered
why_pcm: Dem talk say you win something wey you no enter
examples: Congratulations! You have won an iPhone 15

pattern: \b(?:this is my new (?:number|line)|i(?:'m| am) using (?:a|my) (?:new|friend'?s?) (?:number|line|phone)|it'?s me,? (?:mum|mom|dad|mummy|daddy|bro|sis)|new number,)
why_en: Someone claiming to be family on a new number: call their old number first
why_pcm: Person dey claim say na your family with new number: call their old number first
examples: Mummy it's me, this is my new number

why_en: Asks you to send crypto, which cannot be reversed
why_pcm: Dem wan make you send crypto, and crypto no dey reverse

why_en: Asks you to click a link to 'verify' or 'unblock': banks don't do this
why_pcm: Dem wan make you click link to 'verify': bank no dey do am like that
examples: Click the link below to verify your account
Tap here to reactivate your account

pattern: \b(?:don'?t|do not|never) (?:tell|inform|share this with) (?:anyone|anybody|your bank|your family)\b|\bkeep (?:this|it) (?:secret|confidential|between us)\b
why_en: Asks you to keep it secret: scammers isolate victims
why_pcm: Dem say make you hide am: scammers like make you dey alone
examples: Do not tell anyone about this

why_en: Too-easy loan offer, often a fee or data-theft trap
why_pcm: Loan wey too easy, e fit be fee or data trap

why_en: Uses a government agency's name to scare or rush you
why_pcm: Dem dey use government agency name take scare you
examples: EFCC has flagged your account, pay ₦20,000 fine
